description: Give a record id (obs_YYYY-MM-DD_NNNNNN) or the https URL of a published record. Checks, without taking vet402's word for it: the bytes are the ones the records index lists, the signer is a vet402 observation key, the EIP-712 signature, that the verdict follows from the recorded checks, the Merkle proof to the day's root, the payment on chain over public RPC, and the day's root in a Solana memo sent by vet402's anchor wallet. Result: OK, OK_NOT_ANCHORED, OK_OFFLINE or FAIL, with one line per check.

offline.description: Skip the reads from chain (payment and anchor)

record.description: Record id (obs_2026-09-28_000164) or https URL of a record JSON

name: verify_record
title: Verify one vet402 signed record
